label: Parte 1
subtitle: Preguntas personales · 30 seg cada una
objetivo: Responder directo + 1-2 detalles + cerrar limpio. Sin silencios. Sin enrollarse.

pasos.title: Respuesta directa + ejemplo personal
pasos.template: Yes, I do, actually. I usually [verbo + complemento] because [razón]. For example, [detalle personal concreto].

opciones: go to the gym after work
spend time with my family on Sundays
go for a walk in the park
it helps me clear my mind
last weekend I went hiking with friends
yesterday I cooked pasta for my family
this morning I went for a run before work

pasos.trick: Termina la razón con un phrasal verb: 'unwind', 'switch off', 'recharge my batteries', 'clear my mind'.

pasos.title: Cierre con valoración
pasos.template: It's [adjetivo B2] for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.
pasos.warning: No termines a medias. Usa esta frase corta como cierre limpio.

kits_universales.label: Detalles personales en pasado
items: this morning I went for a run
last month I started a new hobby

temas.label: Hobbies
preguntas: What do you do in your free time?
Do you have any hobbies?
Did you have different hobbies when you were younger?
temas.respuesta_modelo: Yes, I do, actually. I usually read before bed because it helps me unwind and I find it really relaxing. For example, last weekend I finished a great novel about travelling. It's really rewarding for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

temas.label: Your job
preguntas: Tell me about your job.
What do you like most about it?
Would you change anything about your work?
temas.respuesta_modelo: Yes, I do, actually. I usually work in an office from nine to five because it gives me structure and I find it really stimulating. For example, last week I finished an important project with my team. It's fulfilling for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

temas.label: Family
preguntas: Tell me about your family.
Do you spend a lot of time with them?
How important is family for you?
temas.respuesta_modelo: Yes, I do, actually. I usually have lunch with my family on Sundays because it helps me catch up with them and I find it really comforting. For example, last Sunday we had a homemade paella together. It's meaningful for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

temas.label: Weather
preguntas: What's the weather like in your area today?
What kind of weather do you prefer?
How does the weather affect your mood?
temas.respuesta_modelo: Yes, I do, actually. I usually go for a walk when the weather is sunny because it helps me clear my mind and I find it really refreshing. For example, yesterday I walked along the river before lunch. It's refreshing for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

temas.label: Where you live
preguntas: Tell me about where you live.
What do you like about your area?
Is there anything you would change?
temas.respuesta_modelo: Yes, I do, actually. I usually go for a walk in my neighbourhood after work because it helps me switch off and I find it really pleasant. For example, last weekend I discovered a nice café around the corner. It's enjoyable for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

temas.label: Travel plans
preguntas: Do you like travelling?
Where did you go on your last holiday?
Do you have any travel plans for the future?

kit_sugerido.razon: it helps me broaden my horizons

temas.respuesta_modelo: Yes, I do, actually. I usually travel abroad at least once a year because it helps me broaden my horizons and I find it really inspiring. For example, last summer I went to Italy with my family. It's rewarding for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

temas.label: Food / Cooking
preguntas: Do you like cooking?
What's your favourite meal?
How often do you eat out?
temas.respuesta_modelo: Yes, I do, actually. I usually cook at home after work because it helps me unwind and I find it really relaxing. For example, last weekend I made a homemade lasagna for my family. It's rewarding for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.

temas.label: Future plans
preguntas: What are your plans for the future?
Do you have any goals for next year?
Where do you see yourself in five years?
temas.respuesta_modelo: Yes, I do, actually. I usually plan my goals at the start of each year because it keeps me focused and I find it really motivating. For example, last month I started learning French as a new challenge. It's fulfilling for me, and honestly, I wouldn't change it.
